sous_titre: Dépenses alimentaires des États-Unis, en Mds $ constants de 2025, 1997 et 2025

À domicile 1997.texte: Food-at-home expenditures increased to $1.10 trillion from $738 billion over the same period.

Hors domicile 1997.texte: increasing to $1.41 trillion in 2025 from an inflation-adjusted $818 billion in 1997.

À domicile 2025.texte: Food-at-home expenditures increased to $1.10 trillion from $738 billion over the same period.

Hors domicile 2025.texte: increasing to $1.41 trillion in 2025 from an inflation-adjusted $818 billion in 1997.
